ROOT_authority_instruction: Keep FALSE template immutable. Only after complete inspect-state proof and ROOT review create a separate JSON with exact matching plan/manifest/frozen_queue/state_proof/source/counts/journal/output, allow_score_analysis=true, allow_partial=false; bind its full SHA. No authority is created by this template.
actual_executor_source_rule: Use the actual queue/state which contains all67 definitions and completed records, including inherited initial. A future handoff needs its own real queue/state, not an assumed old master. No original check is called by inspect-state.
first_read_semantics: Original check passes -> exclusive per-manifest semantic_access_enabled journal -> original analyze. Journal denotes permission/attempt, not successful parsing; failures remain and cannot reset by changing output folder.
source_policy: Original guard/collector/inventory/analysis/worker/common code unchanged. Only their original check/analyze is called after true authority. Current prepared task artifacts are SHA-verified as opaque input bytes before future analysis, not parsed as outcomes. No checkpoint payload read is added.
whole_process_timing: Timed parent spawns complete CPU worker containing closure recheck, original check, journal and original analyze. resource child CPU includes waited original check/analyze descendants. Whole parent receipt persists even worker fails. Nested timers are not added. Parent prelaunch authority validation and manual signing/writing are outside this child timer.
